title: Domain Artifacts & Task Compiler policy manifest — ADR-0128 §13/§21/§22 (WF-0066)
note: Index of the domain-artifacts policy tables. Single source for the five artifact contracts, the Task Compiler recipe declarations and the governed scaffold contracts — the runtime NEVER embeds these (ADR-0129 §4). policyVersion is the calibration unit's third axis (rule × host × policyVersion).

tables.concern: The five artifact contracts + proportionality by profile (§13)
domain-implementation + four profile recipes over tc-recipe-runner (§21)
Governed scaffolds — typed placeholders, contract-gated release (§22)

changeClasses.observationalAdjustment: shadow/non-blocking field or step tweak; calibration receipt; no ADR when enforcement power is unchanged.
changeClasses.automaticPromotion: rule evolves up to its maximumAutomaticLevel on evidence; no further human action per transition.
changeClasses.changeOfMaximumAuthority: raising maximumAutomaticLevel / accepted evidence types / fail mode — requires a governed Decision.
changeClasses.materialEnforcementChange: new mandatory artifact / new block case / reduced fail-open — requires a Decision and resets rule confidence.
